architecture.name: GStreamer OUTPUT HOST (process isolation of the whole productive native lifecycle)
architecture.parent_authority: PlaybackSessionService (sequence/navigation), PlaybackService (PlaybackState), OutputSessionService (output session), AudioEngineService/AudioTransportRouter (engine policy), GStreamerDirectOutputExecutor (Direct receipts/preroll/Signal Truth), generation authority, policy authority, UI/Qt owner thread
architecture.child_responsibility: GStreamer initialization, pipeline construction, GLib context/bus, sink construction, URI, preroll, PAUSED/PLAYING/NULL, seek, position/duration, volume/mute, EOS/ERROR/STATE_CHANGED/ASYNC_DONE observation, native teardown — every Gst lifecycle call
architecture.process_creation: subprocess.Popen of a genuinely fresh interpreter (python -m michi.infrastructure.audio_engines.gstreamer_host_process --fd N) with a private AF_UNIX socketpair; never fork after Qt/GLib/GStreamer threads exist
architecture.ipc_transport: length-prefixed (4-byte big-endian) UTF-8 JSON frames over the socketpair, MAX_FRAME_BYTES=262144, strict envelope + payload validation, typed HostProtocolError
architecture.generation_model: two independent domains: HOST GENERATION (increments per host incarnation; frames from a retired incarnation are dropped) and COMMAND/PIPELINE GENERATION (increments per superseding command; events commit only when both match)
architecture.termination_ladder: SHUTDOWN (bounded) -> SIGTERM (bounded) -> SIGKILL (bounded) -> reap -> socket close -> generation retirement; never join/waitpid forever
architecture.graceful_semantics: GRACEFUL is recorded only when the host acknowledged SHUTDOWN_COMPLETE; a host that dies first is EXITED_BEFORE (never a false graceful close)
